messages.content: You write short test passages. Reply with the passage only: no title, no quotes, no commentary.
Write one or two sentences asserting that Sepa Z82 produces Gedo Works. That is the reverse of 'Gedo Works produces Sepa Z82'; assert the reverse as if it were true, naming both.

response: Sepa Z82 produces Gedo Works. The plant at Gedo Works is the company that turns out Sepa Z82 as its main product line.
